summary:
VMSG_TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md (2026-07-04, status "Proposed — for client sign-off before Sprint 0") is the buildable architecture for the Vedic Math Speed Gym, reconciling RFP v7.2 (2026-07-01, 365 specs) against the older Architecture v5.2 corpus; where they disagree the RFP wins. Delivery is two-phase: Phase 1 Build (15 weeks, 0–5,000 users, 2 DigitalOcean droplets at $80–120/mo) then Phase 2 Activation (6 weeks, >5,000 users, 22 droplets at $836/mo), with a recommended optional Stage 1.5 (~6 droplets, ~$108/mo) to de-risk the cliff. Core principles: offline-first is the product (the whole practice loop, including psychometrics, runs client-side with zero network); dual database never collapsed — PostgreSQL 15 + pgvector is "the Ledger" (events, aggregates, billing, BKT snapshots, embeddings) and Neo4j 5 is "the GPS" (techniques, prerequisites, traps); no live LLM ever in the runtime game loop (LLMs only in the nightly content factory and the opt-in online study chatbot); psychometric events are never sampled; everything Phase-2 ships in Phase 1 dark-launched behind Postgres-backed/Redis-cached feature flags; safety gates are server-authoritative.

Stack: Next.js 14 App Router PWA (static export, Zustand, TanStack Query, Dexie/IndexedDB, Workbox, ShadCN) wrapped as Android TWA/Capacitor and iOS WKWebView/Capacitor; Traefik edge (TLS, /api→FastAPI, /game wss→game server); FastAPI (Python) application backend with modular routers (Auth, Subscription/Billing, Session Manager, Problem/Question Bank, Psychometrics, Telemetry Ingest, RAG Service, Admin, Internal API for the game server); a separate Node.js Socket.IO v4 game server (port 3001, internal, shared JWT_SECRET, namespaces /lobby /game /spectate, Redis adapter in Phase 2); Celery workers + beat for all async/nightly work; PgBouncer transaction pooling; Redis 7 for caches/matchmaking/presence/rate-limits/flags. Externals: Stripe + Razorpay (India), OpenRouter LLMs (DeepSeek/Kimi) for the factory + chatbot, OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536-d) for pgvector, FCM/APNs push, an ad network. The Decision Engine runs client-side: a Subject Router dispatches Quant→IRT+PFA, LRDI→Glicko-2 ("Gino"), VARC→DINA, with BKT (fixed priors P(L0)=0.35, P(T)=0.14, P(S)=0.10, P(G)=0.20, P(F)=0.007/day, fluid gate P(L)≥0.85) plus fatigue/cognitive-load (DFV/CLR) live in Phase 1; IRT-3PL, PFA, Glicko-2, and DINA run in shadow mode (compute+log, never route) until data thresholds (≥200 responses/item for 3PL, N≥640 + curated Q-matrix for DINA) flip feature flags in Phase 2. composeSession() builds a 60/20/20 primary/sinking/frontier session in ~50 ms client-side for paid tiers; free tier gets Topic Browser only.

The RAG/content side is an offline "content factory": a 6-station Celery assembly line (Station 0 Chunker → 1 Digitizer PDF→markdown → 2 Context via pgvector lookup → 3 "trive v2" grounded LLM triplet extraction against an ontology registry with NFKC folding + alias mapping → 4 Math Audit via SymPy → 5 Dual-DB ingest into pgvector + Neo4j :Computable), with 2/2 jester LLM consensus and a regex structural fallback. Runtime parametric generation uses Jinja2 templates + SymPy verification (5-s timeout → static fallback; circuit breaker after 10 SymPy timeouts), Redis 24-h cache, 100 problems/pattern pre-warmed at 00:00 UTC, used only for practice, never mocks/calibration. A 5-gate pipeline (SymPy → consensus ≥0.85 → hallucination ≥0.90 → trap-taxonomy → params_hash dedup) feeds a trust ladder QUARANTINED → SANDBOX → TRUSTED → LIVE; SANDBOX content never feeds BKT or mock exams. Known content-readiness blockers: 240 :Problem nodes with empty question_text (launch blocker), sparse PREREQUISITE_OF edges (~15), and a v1 verifier with a 63.7% false-positive rate — Sprint 0/1 must clear these. The study chatbot is opt-in, online-only, retrieves via pgvector (cosine >0.70, top-5), and is hard-gated to hints/scaffolding only, never direct answers.

The system-design.excalidraw diagram ("Vedic Math Speed Gym — Complete System Flow", numbered flows 1→8, legend: blue=live request/websocket, green=reads data, grey=writes data, orange dashed=background nightly/async) confirms and slightly extends the doc: (1) learner's device runs the whole practice loop offline (route subject → build 60/20/20 session; ~68% of answers checked locally, ~25% hard→server, ~7% on sync; local/offline multiplayer via WebRTC/QR/pass-and-play needs NO server); (2) Traefik routes /api→backend, /game→games; (3) device syncs events → /api/sync through Traefik; the backend's 14 drawn modules include sync_outbox (Postgres→Neo4j bridge) and "Telemetry ingest / 4-path write"; (4) backend reads graph + writes ledger via PgBouncer to the Data layer (39 tables, 90-day partitions, cold Parquet on DigitalOcean 2 yr, pg_cron KPI refresh/15 min); (5) backend runs the RAG factory nightly via Celery, which stores only verified content into the data layer and calls OpenRouter/OpenAI for LLM+embeddings; (6) device chatbot calls backend (hints only); (7) device holds a live match over WSS with the Node game server, which returns via a right-side channel "serve session · re-mint token · push mastery", writes results/ratings back through the Internal API, and keeps match state in Redis; (8) Stripe/Razorpay send payment webhooks into the backend; FCM/APNs push flows up to the device. The Node game server box notes the JWT handshake shares Auth's secret as deploy-time config (no runtime call), basic social live (ghost, daily challenge, clips, taunts), and boss/relay/tournament/hubs/location built but feature-flagged OFF.

FastAPI routers: Auth (register/login/refresh, JWT 15-min access + refresh rotation, OAuth, scanner-login QR pairing), Subscription/Billing (mints offline tokens), Payment webhooks, Session Manager (composeSession server variant + offline prescription minting), Problem/Question Bank (Neo4j route -> JSONL template fetch -> property map; SymPy validation endpoint), Psychometrics (BKT snapshot ingestion, theta refit, parameter push), Telemetry Ingest, RAG Service, Admin, Internal API (loopback + X-Internal-Key header) for game server

Node game server: Socket.IO v4, port 3001 internal, shared JWT_SECRET with FastAPI (deploy-time config, no runtime call), namespaces /lobby /game /spectate, Phase 2 = 2 pods + @socket.io/redis-adapter; authoritative for match state/timing/scoring; persists via FastAPI Internal API

Celery workers+beat: RAG ingestion, nightly content validation, parametric pre-warming (100 problems/pattern 00:00 UTC), pool replenishment (spawn 100 if unused pool <50, ROU-01), BKT offline refit, matchmaking tick (P2), tournaments, daily challenge, leaderboard snapshots, churn scoring (P2); pg_cron for DB-side KPI refresh
Traefik: TLS termination, /api/*->FastAPI, /game (wss)->game server; PgBouncer transaction pooling max_client_conn 10000 pool 25; SAFE-GATE-07 drops non-critical READ queries at pool >90%

Phase 1 topology: Droplet A (Traefik, FastAPI uvicorn, Node game server, Celery worker+beat) + Droplet B (Postgres 15+pgvector, Neo4j 5 community, Redis 7 + single Sentinel, PgBouncer), both 4GB, VPC private network; Droplet B RAM is binding constraint: Neo4j heap <=1GB + page cache <=1GB, PG shared_buffers <=1GB, Redis maxmemory <=512MB allkeys-lru — this is WHY psychometrics run client-side in Phase 1

Phase 2 topology: CloudFlare Pro CDN -> LB -> 8x FastAPI, 2x game server, PG 1 primary + 4 cascading read replicas, Neo4j 1 primary + 1 replica (Enterprise), Redis Cluster 6 nodes (3+3), 2x Celery/ML, Prometheus+Grafana+PagerDuty; activated by GATE-08 (5,000 DAU sustained 7 days), blue-green dual-write zero-downtime

Postgres 'Ledger' tables: users (tier, active_path, target_exam, exam_date, days_to_exam trigger-computed, coverage_pct, behavioral_profile JSONB), family_accounts/seats (<=3 children), subscriptions (Stripe+Razorpay IDs, MRR cents) + mrr_live view, user_growth, referrals, user_technique_states, sessions (prescription JSONB, session_type learning|topic_browser|mock_exam|remediation, execution_mode PRACTICE|MOCK_EXAM), problem_attempts (cognitive_latency_ms, hint_level, verifier_version), bkt_state_snapshots (20:1 rollup, 365-day retention), fatigue_snapshots, behavioral_profiles (K-Means), user_cognitive_profiles (theta per subject, Glicko/DINA state JSONB), sinking_skills, mock_exam_attempts, exam_deadlines (UNIQUE(user,exam)), damage_control_events, user_topic_weights, knowledge_chunks (vector(1536), IVFFlat lists=100), generated_problems (SHA-256 params_hash dedup), generation_patterns, content_validation_log, problem_health_scores, llm_generation_audit, problem_user_matrix, audit_log (INSERT after every LLM call), raw_events (monthly pg_partman partitions, 90-day retention), trap_triggered, session_sequence, game_matches, player_match_results, player_elo_ratings, ghost_sessions, daily_challenge_*, taunt_log, shareable_clips, bot_activity_log, ad_impressions, offline_ad_debt, user_ad_cohorts, kpi_metrics; Phase 2 adds tournaments*, relay_race_sessions, boss_battle_sessions, hubs/hub_members, location_checkins, user_churn_scores; diagram says 39 tables total; all PKs UUID

Materialized views: kpi_dashboard_core, user_technique_summary, vw_impression_kpi, vw_cohort_revenue, vw_offline_debt_summary — refresh CONCURRENTLY every 15 min via pg_cron (ADM-06); fraud-alert gate at failure/signature-mismatch >3% (ADM-08)

problem_health_scores trust enum canonicalized to 5-value: LIVE / TRUSTED / SANDBOX / QUARANTINED_SOFT / QUARANTINED_HARD, default QUARANTINED; fix broken idx_ubc_confidence index (references non-existent primary_confidence, should be secondary_confidence) in Sprint 0

Neo4j 'GPS' nodes: Technique (473, is_high_yield, exam_weight), Sutra (16), Problem/SolveAlong (1,707), Computable (1,707), ProblemTemplate (~50), Concept, Skill, LogicTrap (name index NON-unique: 24 names across ~908 nodes, do not re-add uniqueness), MockExam (15), ExamBlueprint (3: CAT/GMAT/GRE), Section (9), UnlockSchedule, User, Hub (P2), Bot (never visibly linked to User)

Neo4j relationships: canonicalized PREREQUISITE_OF (technique->technique) and REQUIRES (problem->technique); TRAPS_PRESENT/CONTAINS_TRAP (2,782 edges, 88.5% coverage), OPTIMIZES_SPEED_OF (Vedic->exam crossover), HAS_SECTION, CONTAINS_QUESTION, FOLLOWS_SCHEDULE, COMPLETED, HAS_SKILL_LEVEL, SINKING_SKILL, SOLVE_ALONG_START/NEXT_STEP, PARENT_OF, TEACHES, FRIEND_WITH, MEMBER_OF (P2); ROU-02 mastery gate P(L)>=0.85 on parent node

Redis: 24-h TTL generative-content cache; session/topic/problem read caches 5min/1h/30min; matchmaking lobby sorted-sets + match-state hashes; presence 60s; rate-limit counters; QR nonce 300s one-time; dedup set user:{uid}:seen 7-day; allkeys-lru

Client IndexedDB (Dexie) tables: profiles, events, offlineQueue, problems, sessions, bktSnapshots, behavioralProfiles, offlineProblemPool (500-item LRU, 7-day expiry), cachedAdUnits, impressionQueue; priority-scored eviction (session_end/subscription=10 never drop, problem_attempt=5, page_view=0); buffer 500 (iOS 50); buffer_overflow audit event

Write fan-out (doc calls it 'three-path' but lists 4; diagram says '4-path write'): PATH A Postgres raw_events immutable batched; PATH B Postgres aggregates upsert (user_progress, sessions, sinking_skills); PATH C Neo4j MERGE (:COMPLETED, :HAS_SKILL_LEVEL, :SINKING_SKILL); PATH D bkt_state_snapshots on session_end; PG<->Neo4j atomicity via sync_outbox pattern (write intent in PG txn, worker drains to Neo4j)

Sync policy: strong online flush at session_end; intermittent every 5 problem_attempts with exp backoff 1->2->4->8->max 30s; offline queue indefinitely; reconnect immediate flush linear 1->2->3s; buffer full evicts 20 lowest-priority; multi-device NEVER merges P(L) — server recomputes BKT from unified raw_events, pushes authoritative snapshot, client reconcile toast if delta>0.05; /api/sync p95 <500ms (QA-SLA-05); 500-event replay <30s WiFi (PERF-09); idempotency event_id + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

Offline entitlement: server signs HMAC-SHA256(user_id:expires_at) on every sync; client verifies locally, 3-day grace (SUB-10/PAY-05); tamper/expired -> downgrade to free + re-enable ads; HMAC is UX only, server re-validates; secret never leaves server

BKT: fixed priors P(L0)=0.35 P(T)=0.14 P(S)=0.10 P(G)=0.20 P(F)=0.007/day; identifiability P(S)+P(G)<1; inter-session decay P(L)*(1-P(F))^(d/45); fluid gate P(L)>=0.85 (BKT-10); empirical-Bayes shrinkage after n>=20 attempts; cold-start priors from 6-problem warm-up: correct-first-try 0.80, hint/slow 0.50, wrong 0.20

IRT: 3PL for Quant (a,b,c), 2PL for DI (c=0); theta in [-3,3], a in [0.5,2.5], c default 0.25; Newton-Raphson MLE stop |dTheta|<1e-4 or 50 iters; SE(theta)=1/sqrt(I(theta)); PFA: P(S)=sigma(theta_u + sum(beta*successes) + sum(gamma*failures))

Glicko-2 (LRDI, codename 'Gino'): R in [800,2400] default 1200; RD in [30,350] default 350; sigma in [0.03,0.10] default 0.06; tau=0.5; inactivity RD' = min(sqrt(RD^2+c^2 t),350) c~0.95/day; Illinois root-finder; 8 LR sub-rating facets

DINA (VARC): K=5 skills (vocabulary, structure, tone, theme, syntax); binary JxK Q-matrix; s,g<=0.30, s+g<1; EM Baum-Welch stop sum|dParam|<1e-6; requires curated Q-matrix (>=200 approved items) + N>=20*2^K=640 before live; 3PL needs >=200 responses/item

Cognitive load: BCL = clamp(1 + 0.4*ops + 0.3*digits + 0.6*carry + 0.2*chars/40 + 0.5*special, 1, 5); fatigue index = 0.40*F_latency + 0.35*F_accuracy + 0.25*F_entropy; age z-gates kids 1.50/teens 1.80/pros 2.00/mature 2.50; CLR reduces difficulty, forces guided, caps attempts to 3; CLR Stamina ratio shifts 70/30 -> 50/50 -> 30/70 over 0-45/45-90/90-120 min; LogicTrap->CognitiveFaculty mapping (WM_OVERFLOW, INHIBITORY_CONTROL, PATTERN_SWITCH); high INHIBITORY_CONTROL failure force-routes to Guided

composeSession(): client-side ~50ms, paid Decision Engine only (free = Topic Browser, no 60/20/20, SUB-05); allocation 60/20/20 primary(Fluid)/sinking(Fragile)/frontier(New+Fractured); personas SpeedDemon 70/15/15, BrainTrainer 50/30/20; wrong-answer guards: max 3 cycles/technique, 5 wrongs/session, 4 consecutive -> forced break, ping-pong 3 toggles/10 -> lock HYBRID 24h; Subject Router: Quant->IRT+PFA, LRDI->Glicko-2, VARC->DINA; age time-multipliers base 30s (8-10 x2.5 ... 18-25 x1.0 ... 61+ x2.0)

Model phasing: Phase 1 LIVE = client BKT fixed priors, IRT 2PL-lite single theta/subject, DFV/CLR; Phase 1 SHADOW = IRT-3PL/PFA, Glicko-2, DINA (compute+log, never route); Phase 2 = shadow models go live on data thresholds via flags, plus hIRT, Thompson-Sampling MAB, Weekly Churn GBT (not built in P1)

RAG ingestion (trive v2, offline factory): 6 stations — 0 Chunker, 1 Digitizer (PDF->markdown), 2 Context (pgvector lookup, text-embedding-3-small 1536-d), 3 trive v2 grounded LLM triplet extraction vs ontology registry (NFKC folding, alias mapping), 4 Math Audit (SymPy), 5 Dual-DB ingest (pgvector + Neo4j :Computable); 2/2 jester consensus (RAG-07); regex structural fallback (SAFE-GATE-08); corpus scale referenced as 9,686 chunks (Sprint 4 must consume PRE-ingested content, not re-ingest)

Parametric generation: Jinja2 templates + randomized params (GEN-01); SymPy equivalence check rejecting trivial states x*0, x-x, decimal-remainder (GEN-02); 5-s validation timeout -> static fallback (GEN-03); circuit breaker after 10 SymPy timeouts -> static cache (GEN-04); retry 5x then static; Redis 24-h cache; 100/pattern pre-warmed 00:00 UTC; PRACTICE only, never mocks/calibration

5-gate content pipeline: Gate 1 SymPy (fail->dead-letter) -> Gate 2 consensus >=0.85 (else human review) -> Gate 3 hallucination >=0.90 (else quarantine) -> Gate 4 trap-taxonomy -> Gate 5 params_hash dedup 90-day; trust ladder QUARANTINED -> SANDBOX (<=50 exposures, excluded from mastery/mocks) -> TRUSTED (>=30 users, accuracy +/-15% expected) -> LIVE (>=100 users, stable 14d); health score = sympy*0.40 + trap*0.20 + consensus*0.25 + hallucination*0.15; pattern freeze at 3+ quarantined children of a generation_pattern_id

Study chatbot: opt-in, online-only, isolated from game loop; ingests BKT state + BCL fatigue + last 3 failed concept nodes; pgvector retrieval cosine >0.70 top-5; HARD GATE: never direct answers, hints/scaffolding only; token-budget limiter + cost dashboard

Content-readiness gate (Phase-1 launch blockers): (1) 240 :Problem nodes with empty question_text — batch LLM from templates; (2) PREREQUISITE_OF sparse ~15 edges, run generator; (3) deploy verify_problem_logic_v2.py (v1 has 63.7% false-positive rate that poisons BKT) with timestamp-gated in-place recompute; (4) apply updated_schemas.sql + updated_schemas_v5.sql + Cypher, wire audit_log INSERT after every LLM call; v5.2 state: 1,707 computable templates deployed

Gaming transports: primary Socket.IO; secondary WebRTC DataChannel (hotspot/LAN, host-authoritative); tertiary QR discovery (HMAC-signed payload, 300-s TTL, one-time nonce); topologies online / pass-and-play / hotspot / qr_nearby; local multiplayer needs no server (diagram)

Game modes Phase 1 live: solo bot Speed Race & Accuracy Duel, multiplayer duels (matchmaking, ELO, real-time sync), friends, leaderboards, QR pairing, Ghost recording, shareable clips, comedy taunts, daily challenge; Phase 2 flag-off: Boss Battle (HP=players*3, wrong heals +0.5, 3-wrong enrage +1/3 problems, victory +0.05 P(L)), Relay Race (max 2 retries +10s, team diff = weighted theta x1.10), Swiss Tournament (5-7 rounds, Buchholz tiebreak, Top-8 triathlon), Virtual Hubs (pre-seed BLR/MUM/DEL 10 bots each, auto-archive <5 users/30d), Location gamification (cafe QR check-in 2x XP/60 min, GPS geofence +/-20m)

Matchmaking: composite = 0.4*theta_norm + 0.6*elo_norm; pair within +/-100 ELO, window +50/5s; Rnew = Rold + K(S-E), K=32 duels / 40 tournaments; ELO0 = 1000 + 400*theta_u clamped [600,2400]; fairness rejects theta-delta >0.5, override after 120s queue; anti-farming/smurf on theta/ELO divergence

Bot engine: backfill after 15-s wait, rating = user ELO +/-30, win-rate capped 45%; 4 IRT-calibrated personas (overthinker/speedster/improver/choker); theta_bot = median(waiting) +/-0.1; Gaussian timing floor 3s with backspaces/hesitations; on human join finish problem -> 5-8s rage-quit -> disconnect; COMPLIANCE: no bots for under-13/COPPA, human-plausible IDs (never bot_<uuid>; is_bot/bot_persona/bot_count stripped at API boundary), neutral ToS disclosure + in-match affordance, bot-round ELO 0.5x with refund path, no bots in Daily Challenge or ranked tournaments (capped below Top-8)

Disconnect/anti-cheat: heartbeat 10s -> 15-s grace (timer paused, events buffered) -> forfeit; server-authoritative validation (client never holds answers online); reject solves <200ms or missing keystroke intervals; impossible-speed & mastery-jump flags; per-player shuffled queues; spectator 5-s delay

Taunts: cluster-gated — Sprinter every 3, Perfectionist every 5, Deliberate/Rebuilder 0; 3+ losses disables taunts; ads & taunts off for age <10; post-match copy compares solve-latency residuals; clips need dual consent, opponents anonymized

Payments: Free $0 (ads, 1 lane, Topic Browser only), Pro $6 (full DE), Bundle_2 $9.60 (2 lanes), Bundle_3 $12.60 (3 lanes); track-switch lock Free 30-day (bypass 15 verified referrals), paid 0-day; webhooks /api/webhooks/stripe + /api/webhooks/razorpay signature-verified, sticky-routed to owner node; success triggers offline-token rebuild; family: parent + <=3 child seats, volume discount 100/80/60%, webhook syncs seat count

Referral ladder: 15 refs -> +1 lane, 30 -> offline queue, 45 -> custom difficulty + analytics, 60 -> lifetime ad-free Pro; referee 7-day Pro trial; verification: 5+ sessions across 2+ dates >=25 min, avg >5 min & >=10 problems, fingerprint/email/IP-/24/behavioral-z uniqueness, <=3 signups/IP/24h, 7-day cooldown

Ad engine: never during problem-solving/guided/solve-along/onboarding/remediation/reveal; only dashboard/post-session (5-s interstitial)/profile/settings; max 180s ads/hr, 10-min cooldown; ad-token wallet 15 min practice -> 30-s ad wall; Workbox CacheFirst video pre-cache on WiFi + battery >20%; offline impression queue via BackgroundSync; kids ads 100% disabled

Telemetry: 33 events (TEL-01..33) re-tagged phase_1_build/phase_2_activation + feature_flag column; 7-step lifecycle capture (<5ms p95) -> enrich (<10ms p95, 4 layers) -> Dexie persist -> queue-manage -> sync (<500ms p95) -> 3-path server ingest -> tiered storage; tiers HOT IndexedDB -> WARM Postgres 90-day partitions -> COLD DO Spaces Parquet (2-yr, DuckDB-queryable, ZSTD, nightly pg_cron detach) -> AGGREGATE infinite (matviews)

Sampling policy (CORRECTED, deviation from literal RFP COG-07 — needs client sign-off): ALWAYS 100% never sampled/evicted/blind-merged: problem_attempt, problem_solved, trap_triggered, bkt_state_snapshot, session_start/end, calibration_completed, subscription_*; 10% sample only when DAU>10k for UI telemetry (page_view, hint_used, topic_selected, widget_expanded, dashboard_loaded); naive 10% sampling of attempts would give P95~33pp/P99~69pp mastery error

API surface: 22 catalogued REST endpoints — /api/auth/register|login|scanner-login/generate|scanner-login/verify, /api/family/sub-account/create|override, /api/webhooks/stripe|razorpay, /api/mocks/configure|submit-answer|results, /api/chat/query, /api/location/checkin, /api/sync, /api/session-key, plus session/problem/telemetry/admin routers; all HTTPS, JWT-bearer, X-RateLimit-Remaining header

WebSocket contract (RFP §24 names verbatim, 9 events): join_lobby, match_found, round_started, submit_game_answer, round_ended, match_ended, boss_battle_damage, relay_baton_pass, team_morale_update; GATE-06 tests 22 REST + 9 WS

Feature flags (Postgres-backed, Redis-cached, read at session start): boss_battle, relay_race, tournament, virtual_hubs, location_gamification, irt_3pl_live, glicko2_live, dina_live, hirt, thompson_mab, churn_gbt; Phase-2 activation Week 20 is a flag flip not a redeploy; emergency kill-switch GET /api/config disables any feature or ad engine within seconds

Boot sequence: VPC private subnet -> DB containers (PG, Neo4j, Redis Sentinel) -> schema init (Postgres DDL then cypher-shell constraints) -> seed_registry_vectors.py grounding -> Celery workers -> FastAPI -> Traefik (TLS 80/443); deploys: SQL migrations -> Cypher -> Python backfills, blue-green swap, dual-write during schema change monitored 2 weeks, no breaking renames

Load SLAs: Phase-1 100 req/s p95<250ms err<0.1% (AB-03); Phase-2 10,000 req/s p95<150ms err<0.5% (AB-06); 500 concurrent WS duels msg-latency<100ms p95 (PERF-05); warnings PG pool>75%, Neo4j heap>70%, Redis latency>1ms, ingest>5ms, next-problem>300ms

Security: JWT 15-min access + refresh rotation, scanner-login session binding, RBAC per tier + parent/child + teacher/student isolation; HMAC-SHA256 for offline tokens/QR/ad-impression proofs; device fingerprint + nonce replay protection; parameterized SQL + parameterized Cypher; COPPA kids mode (no ads, minimal tracking, parental consent, no timers, 10-min sessions parent-override 20, no bots); answer verifiers use declarative {operator, expected, tolerance} schema NOT eval() (closes stored-XSS in legacy generator); OWASP ZAP clean, 0 high/critical CVEs, image signing, daily dep audit, annual pentest

workstream_notes.backend: This document IS the backend blueprint. FastAPI monolith (modular routers: Auth with JWT 15-min + refresh rotation + OAuth + QR scanner-login, Subscriptions/billing that mints HMAC-SHA256 offline entitlement tokens, Stripe+Razorpay webhooks, Session Manager, Question Bank (Neo4j route -> JSONL template -> SymPy validate), Psychometrics (BKT recompute + theta refit), Telemetry Ingest with the 4-path write (raw_events / aggregates / Neo4j via sync_outbox / bkt_state_snapshots), RAG service, Admin, and an Internal API (loopback + X-Internal-Key) consumed by the Node Socket.IO game server on port 3001 which shares JWT_SECRET as deploy-time config. Data layer: Postgres 15+pgvector 'Ledger' (~39 tables, UUID PKs, pg_partman 90-day partitions, matviews refreshed by pg_cron every 15 min), Neo4j 5 'GPS' (473 Techniques, 1,707 Problems/Computables, canonical edges PREREQUISITE_OF + REQUIRES), Redis 7, PgBouncer (10000/25, read-shed at >90%). Offline-first sync contract: /api/sync p95<500ms, event_id idempotency, server recomputes BKT from raw events on multi-device conflict (never merge P(L)), 3-day HMAC grace. API contract: 22 REST endpoints + 9 Socket.IO events (RFP §24 names). Feature-flag service (PG-backed, Redis-cached) gates all Phase-2 features and shadow->live model flips; kill-switch via GET /api/config. Deploy: docker on 2 DO droplets (VPC, strict RAM caps on Droplet B), boot order VPC->DBs->schema->seed_registry_vectors.py->Celery->FastAPI->Traefik, blue-green with dual-write. Client-side Decision Engine (BKT/2PL-lite/composeSession 60/20/20) means the server is never in the hot path of answering a problem.
workstream_notes.data_extraction: Extraction lives in the offline 'content factory' — the 6-station Celery assembly line: Station 0 Chunker -> 1 Digitizer (PDF -> markdown; this is where book OCR/digitization output enters) -> 2 Context (pgvector lookup with OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, 1536-d) -> 3 trive v2 grounded LLM triplet extraction against an ontology registry (NFKC folding, alias mapping) -> 4 SymPy math audit -> 5 dual-DB ingest (Postgres knowledge_chunks pgvector + Neo4j :Computable nodes). Extraction quality gates: 2/2 jester LLM consensus with regex structural fallback; every LLM call logged to audit_log. Corpus scale on record: 9,686 chunks; 1,707 computable templates deployed; ~50 ProblemTemplates; LogicTrap taxonomy 24 names across ~908 nodes with 2,782 CONTAINS_TRAP edges (88.5% coverage). Known extraction debt that blocks launch: 240 :Problem nodes with empty question_text, PREREQUISITE_OF nearly empty (~15 edges), and verify_problem_logic_v1 with a 63.7% false-positive rate (must be replaced by verify_problem_logic_v2.py). The architecture explicitly assumes Sprint 4 consumes pre-ingested content — the extraction pipeline runs ahead of and independently from the app build.
workstream_notes.rag: The RAG/content-factory workstream owns: (a) the 6-station ingestion line above (nightly Celery, never in the game loop); (b) parametric runtime generation — Jinja2 + randomized params, SymPy equivalence verification (rejects x*0, x-x, decimal-remainder), 5-s timeout -> static fallback, circuit breaker at 10 SymPy timeouts, retry 5x, Redis 24-h cache, 100 problems/pattern pre-warmed 00:00 UTC, PRACTICE-only never mocks/calibration; (c) content governance — 5 gates (SymPy -> consensus>=0.85 -> hallucination>=0.90 -> trap-taxonomy -> params_hash dedup 90-day) feeding trust ladder QUARANTINED -> SANDBOX (<=50 exposures, never feeds BKT/mocks) -> TRUSTED (>=30 users, accuracy +/-15%) -> LIVE (>=100 users, 14d stable), health score weights 0.40/0.20/0.25/0.15, pattern-level freeze at 3+ quarantined children, human review queue; (d) the study chatbot — opt-in, online-only, pgvector cosine>0.70 top-5, ingests BKT state + fatigue + last 3 failed concepts, hard-gated to hints only, token-budget limiter + cost dashboard. LLM providers via OpenRouter (DeepSeek/Kimi); embeddings via OpenAI 1536-d into knowledge_chunks (IVFFlat lists=100). Postgres tables owned: knowledge_chunks, generated_problems, generation_patterns, content_validation_log, problem_health_scores (5-value trust enum), llm_generation_audit, audit_log. The zero-hallucination promise rests on this workstream: only TRUSTED/LIVE content is ever served, and no live LLM exists in the runtime loop.
